game.name: Fifa 09 (Europe)(Fr,De,It)
game.desc: Put on your boots, the 2009 version of FIFA on Xbox 360 is getting a head start, with no less than 250 changes announced, some major, some minor. In the end, the development of the "Become a Pro" mode over 4 seasons and above all the possibility of playing 10 against 10 online are the major contributions of this vintage.
